name: Identity and selector echo
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Upper 24 bits did not change after individual write attempts. An ordinary register write did not move selector 4a to 4b.
unknown: Manufacturing encoding and behaviour before initialization.

name: Frequency recipe
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Bits 17–20 retained isolated changes on two selected ASICs. Each candidate was restored before software-reset mode 1. Mode 1 retained the restored word d0d80222; changed-candidate retention through reset was not tested.
unknown: Other bit groups, absolute clock and complete frequency law.
contrast_baseline: d0d80222; isolated trials used comparison word d0c60222

name: Independent configuration word
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Each of the nine set bits at positions 0, 2, 5, 6, 8, 18, 20, 22 and 29 could be cleared, read and restored on two ASICs. Mode 1 retained the tested bit 0 clear marker 20540164. Reset retention of the other changed candidates was not tested. Changes to ASIC 08 did not change this word.
unknown: Zero-bit mask and clock or performance meaning.

name: Operating word
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Clearing bit 20 suppressed the selected fixed-job output. Restoration resumed output. Clearing bit 23 retained positive core-02 behaviour in the selected tests.
unknown: Other fields and the internal cause of the output change.

name: Configuration word
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: The directed bit 13 clear changed 00012111 to 00010111 while the other selector stayed unchanged. Each candidate was restored before mode 1. Mode 1 retained restored 00012111. Retention of the changed word through reset was not tested.
unknown: Electrical drive strength. The firmware label does not establish this.

name: Diagnostic counter
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Directed zero cleared only the selected counter. Observed 65535→65536→65537 establishes at least 17 count bits. Nearby broadcast register reads can disturb the output/count relationship. The overall counter-boundary run failed. A separate physical wire-order synthesis proves the boundary observation.
unknown: Full width, counted event and lossless polling schedule.

name: Software-reset recipe
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Tested ASIC 44 writes changed selected core 02 markers to 000013 and core 0a to 000001 while retaining selected ASIC words. ASIC 44 sampled readback stayed 00000003. Mode 1 interrupted selected active fixed-job output.
unknown: Independent meaning of each bit and complete state-erasure behaviour.

name: Work-length configuration
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Single-bit tests gave retaining mask 000001ff around 2f. Bit 9 did not retain. At 50=2f, the tested 48-byte image was accepted. At 50=2e, the tested 47-byte image was rejected and prior work continued. Restoring 2f admitted the next 48-byte image. Wire lengths were 54 and 53 bytes.
unknown: General length law and arbitrary upper-bit combinations.

name: Result-length configuration
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Values 0–7 produced frames of 7–14 bytes in fixed-job tests. Values 0, 1 and 2 could split one original result into multiple frames. One value 0 burst had three frames. The retaining mask was 00000007 around 07. Bit 3 did not retain. Short fragments are not full validated nonce submissions.
unknown: General encoding outside the tested values and states.

name: UART configuration
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Physical low/fast transitions and readback were tested. Mode 1 retained 00001a00; restoration to 00000100 gave valid identity responses.
unknown: Clock/divisor formula and untested baud settings.

name: Temperature access setup
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Bits 24, 28 and 17 retained changes. Valid c4 responses required bits 28 and 17 in the selected controls. Bit 24 did not change the zero/nonzero outcome.
unknown: Internal sensor conversion and other fields.

name: Temperature result
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Directed disable returned zero for the target while another selector stayed valid. Rearming gave an initial zero response, then a fresh valid response.
unknown: External calibration, update latency bound and upper-field meanings.

name: Configuration word
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Clearing bits 2, 5 and 6 together produced 80000000 and silenced the selected core 02 reply. Exact c8 restoration and the tested mode 1 recovery did not restore it. Board reset followed by full initialization restored the reply. Individual and pair-clear states retained selected replies. Pair-clear words 80000040, 80000020 and 80000004 retained qualified output in matched controls. Other recovery sequences were not qualified.
unknown: Individual timing units and internal cause of the combined change.

name: Configuration word
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Bit 30 was absent from rapid readback after both set and clear writes. Bit 0 retained directed changes. Selected output continued.
unknown: Masked, ignored or auto-cleared interpretation of bit 30; timing units.

name: Core configuration
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Low 16 bits retained writes; the upper 8 bits did not retain in the tested 24-bit access. Values 5a5a, ffff and ffffff retained output. ASIC software reset mode 1 cleared a positive marker.
unknown: Physical enable mask, lane count and rate.

name: Core configuration and output filter
recipe_or_observed_value: Startup write 00007f; mining 000025; sampled ASIC-reset read 000013
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Bits 0–6 retained isolated changes. ASIC reset modes 1 and 3 changed selected markers to 000013, not zero. Core 44 value 2 retained the 02 marker. The 25→27→25 test excluded score 38 opportunities while higher-score output continued.
unknown: Universal score law and internal filter/queue order.

name: Writable core state
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: After ASIC software reset, directed 000001→000000 gave three equal readbacks on each target. Sibling and other-chip state remained unchanged. Matched reset 1 restored 000001. Later active bit 4 tests read 000010→000000→000010. Selected target frames continued while bracketing reads were zero. Sibling and other-chip controls retained 000010. Core 02 retained 000025. Reassertion followed the original work phase rather than clear age.
unknown: Full writable mask, bit 4 trigger, overflow and saturation law. The firmware label is not proof.

name: Core configuration
scope: Physical contrasts used the tapped chain 2 at the 300 MHz reference recipe. Stock startup values describe a separate recipe. Each claim is limited to its stated selectors and test windows.
observation: Value 2 retained a positive core-02 marker in the isolated matched controls.
